title: nan
authors: Chen Z.; Wang C.; Wang H.; Ma Y.; Liang G.; Wu X.
key_contribution: Presents a loosely-coupled visual-inertial sensor fusion framework based on Kernel Adaptive Filtering (KLMS in tensor product RKHS) for UAV indoor navigation in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
